risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantified and provides useful sensitivity, liquidity, funding, and loan-sale details, but it highlights meaningful risks from high funding costs, commercial real estate exposure, wildfire-affected collateral, valuation assumptions, and a material multifamily loan-sale loss. Management uses moderately optimistic forward-looking language regarding profitability, funding costs, and liquidity, while outcomes remain dependent on interest rates, credit performance, and model assumptions.
